Лучший в мире торт — шоколадный! 🍫💥 Серьёзно, после этого рецепта все остальные просто отдыхают 😏 Шоколадный рай своими руками  🍰 Ингредиенты Бисквит: 🥚 Яйца — 4 шт 🍬 Сахар — 100 г 🌾 Мука — 80 г 🍫 Какао — 20 г ✨ Разрыхлитель — 5 г 🧈 Сливочное масло — 25 г Крем: 🍼 Сгущённое молоко — 200 г 🥛 Молоко — 200 г 🥚 Яйцо — 1 шт 🍫 Какао — 20 г 🍫 Шоколад — 50 г 🌽 Крахмал кукурузный — 20 г 🧈 Масло сливочное — 110 г Пропитка: 💧 Вода — 140 г 🍫 Какао — 10 г 🍬 Сахар — 15 г 🍓 Малиновый джем — по вкусу Глазурь: 🍫 Шоколад (72%) — 80 г 🥛 Сливки (33%) — 80 г 👩🏻‍🍳 Приготовление Бисквит: 1️⃣ Раздели яйца на белки и желтки. Белки взбей до плотных пиков. 2️⃣ К желткам добавь сахар и взбей до светлой пышной массы. 3️⃣ Соедини обе части, аккуратно перемешай. 4️⃣ Просей муку, какао и разрыхлитель — вмешай лопаткой. 5️⃣ Добавь растопленное масло, перемешай и выпекай при 180 °C ~35 мин. 6️⃣ Остуди, разрежь на 3–4 коржа. Крем: 1️⃣ Смешай сгущёнку, молоко, яйцо, какао и крахмал. 2️⃣ Вари до загустения, добавь шоколад, остуди. 3️⃣ Взбей масло и по частям введи заварную массу — до кремовой нежности. Пропитка: Смешай воду, какао и сахар. Провари пару минут, добавь джем. Остуди. Сборка: Пропитай каждый корж сиропом, промажь кремом. Собери торт, оберни плёнкой и убери в холодильник на 3–4 часа. Глазурь: Сливки нагрей (не кипяти), залей шоколад и размешай до глянца. Покрой холодный торт и укрась по вдохновению ✨ #cooking #cake #chocolate #шоколадныйторт #торт

Pain au Chocolat Recipe 🍫🥐 An Delight of Tender Chocolate and Airy Pastry. The classic elegance of Pain au Chocolat enchants taste buds around the world. This French pastry is an irresistible delicacy, weaving its magic across palates. It's an experience that shouldn't be missed. Makes 8-10 pieces 🥛 Dough: - 180 ml chilled milk - 18 g sugar - 25 g fresh yeast - 35 g cold butter - About 6 g salt - 380 g flour (Type 550) 🍫 Filling: - 160 g cold butter - 16-20 dark chocolate strips 🥚 Brushing: - Egg yolk - 1 tbsp cream/milk 👩🏻‍🍳 Dough Prep: 1. Mix dough ingredients in a kitchen mixer, knead for 5 min. 2. Take needed butter from the fridge for lamination. 3. Roll dough to 21x25 cm. Lamination: 1. Halve 160 g butter lengthwise. 2. Fold dough over butter, wrap, chill 45+ min. 1st Turn: 1. Roll dough to 8-10 mm, fold in thirds, chill 45+ min. 2nd Turn: 1. Treat rolled dough, fold, chill 45+ min. 3rd Turn: 1. Roll, fold, chill 1-2 hours. 🥐 Shaping and Baking: 1. Roll proofed dough to 15x4 mm. 2. Cut 15 cm x 8.5 cm strips. 3. Place halved chocolate bars on dough, roll. 4. Put rolled dough, seams down, on parchment-lined sheet. 5. Proof 2-2.5 hours at room temp. 6. Brush with egg yolk, cream/milk mixture. 7. Preheat oven to 180°C (356°F), bake 20 min. Optional: Brush with maple syrup after baking. Enjoy your homemade Pain au Chocolat! 🥐🍫  #painauchocolat #dessert #cake #dessertrecipe

I just wanted to bake chocolate lava cakes... Instead Evelyn cracked me, in more way than one. 🥀🍫😭 #househusbandbakes #evelynchevalier #evelynzzz #animecouplegoals #animetok  This recipe makes 4 chocolate lava cakes.  Ingredients:  • 1/2 cup (4 ounces) unsalted butter, plus more for greasing the ramekins • 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting the ramekins • 6 ounces bittersweet or dark chocolate, chopped (about 1 cup plus 1 1/2 tablespoons) You can sub in chocolate chips if its all you have. • 2 large eggs, room temperature • 2 large egg yolks, room temperature • 1/4 cup granulated sugar • 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt Directions:  Gather the ingredients. ● Preheat oven to 450°F. Butter and lightly flour four 6-ounce ramekins. Tap out excess flour. Set the ramekins on a baking sheet. ● Fill a pan/pot with water to a depth of 1 or 2 Inches depending on the depth of the pot; bring to a boil over medium-high and reduce heat to medium-low to maintain a simmer. Combine chocolate and butter in a medium size heatproof bowl and set bowl over simmering water in pan, making sure bottom of bowl doesn't touch water. Cook over medium-low, stirring occasionally and adjusting heat as needed to maintain a simmer, until chocolate mixture is melted and smooth, 10 to 20 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside. ● Beat eggs, egg yolks, sugar, and salt in a medium bowl with an electric mixer fitted with the whisk attachment on high speed until thickened and pale, 2 to 3 minutes ● Whisk melted chocolate until smooth ● Quickly fold melted chocolate mixture and flour into egg mixture in bowl until well combined and no streaks remain. ● Spoon batter into prepared ramekins (about 1/2 cup per ramekin) and smooth the top using a small offset spatula if needed. Place baking sheet with ramekins in the preheated oven; bake until tops of cakes are just set and edges spring back when touched but centers still feel soft, about 9 to 12 minutes. ● Remove cakes from oven and let cool in ramekins on baking sheet for 1 minute. Working with one ramekin at a time, cover ramekin with an inverted plate. Carefully turn over and let stand 10 seconds before lifting the ramekin to unmold cake. Repeat with remaining cakes. Dust with powdered sugar if you want the dominos pizza lavs cake look. Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 3 days. Microwave briefly to reheat.
